summary: Implemented three approved performance slices without tests/benchmarks/browser/probes/synthetic data. (1) Room/question create and unlocked save use RETURNING projections, removing redundant post-write reads while preserving auth, HR scope, locks, validation, receipts and self-paced semantics; structural statements room 3->2, add question 5->4, unlocked save 6->5. (2) Builder editor renders from workspace immediately; report loads only for visible Dashboard/HR/ended results, with no per-frame report request while editing, R10 max-one-in-flight plus dirty/trailing latch, monotonic report-revision guard, loading/stale/error/retry UI, and deduplicated room-list load per token. (3) Latest text answers are fetched with one set-based row_number(rn<=3) query per room instead of per-text-question N+1, preserving score/poll aggregates, n, latest-3 ordering, cursor/has_more and full View-all semantics. Existing indexes inspected; separate index proposal recorded with no migration. Compile checks only: tsc exit 0, web build exit 0, API Bun compile exit 0. No runtime tests/benchmarks/browser/DB/cloud evidence; no speedup claim.
